name: io.github.iowarp/geo-mcp
title: CLIO Geo
description: MCP server for rendering GeoJSON vector layers into map images with basemaps

tools.name: render_feature_map
tools.description: Render one or more GeoJSON layers (polygons/lines/points) onto a single map PNG with an optional basemap. Each layer accepts a style with fixed colors or data-driven coloring (color_by + category_colors, an 'epa_aqi' AQI scale, or a matplotlib colormap). Returns the output path and bounds.
